title.narrative: Democracy Hub: Empowering Georgian Youth through Youth Houses

description.narrative: The joint project between Silba and * aims to foster democratic values and strengthen civil society among Georgian youth, aligning with both organizations' missions. In the preparatory visit, our focus lies on two key objectives: 1) understanding Georgian youth's interest and engagement in politics and civic activism; 2) and strengthening collaboration between Silba and *. Specifically, we aim to gain insights into youth engagement in social issues, identify critical topics, and determine effective activities to address them. Additionally, we seek to understand the operational challenges faced by existing social activism projects and identify optimal formats for engagement, including the necessity of youth houses in various regions. Establishing a specific target group and developing a collaborative framework that addresses local threats are integral components of this study. Furthermore, we will discuss division of responsibilities within our team to enhance communication and streamline our working methods.
